name: mandilink
description: Offline-capable multilingual mandi price PWA for farmers + admin portal

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT,ADMIN" -c "blueBright,greenBright,magentaBright" "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=client" "npm run dev --workspace=admin"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=admin
